say:1:1330433001:1.text: That's our standard procedure—always prepare extra ice when making a statue.
say:1:1330433001:1.source_cn: 以前为了雕像建造顺利，我们也会多准备一些冰块。
say:1:1330433001:1.male: That's our standard procedure—always prepare extra ice when making a statue.
say:1:1330433001:1.female: That's our standard procedure—always prepare extra ice when making a statue.

say:2:1330433002:1.text: But now, there's nowhere to store all this leftover ice! Gosh, did they have too much free time on their hands?
say:2:1330433002:1.source_cn: 可现在剩下的冰块实在太多，根本就没处放！见鬼，他们有力...
say:2:1330433002:1.male: But now, there's nowhere to store all this leftover ice! Gosh, did they have too much free time on their hands?
say:2:1330433002:1.female: But now, there's nowhere to store all this leftover ice! Gosh, did they have too much free time on their hands?
